name: label
title: Label
description: shadcn-compatible Label on Radix in the label-lg type role; dims when its control is disabled, turns red when invalid.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Label as LabelPrimitive } from "radix-ui" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" /** * Velvet Label (built on Radix Label) * *
* * *
* * For controls that have no floating label of their own (Checkbox, Switch, * Radio Group, Slider). Text fields (Input, Select, Textarea ...) draw their * own label and don't need this. * * Same API as shadcn's Label. It reads as a label-lg line and dims with its * control: put it after a `peer` control (Checkbox, Switch and Radio Group are * peers) and it follows `disabled` and `aria-invalid` without extra props, or * wrap both in a `group` with `data-disabled="true"`. Set `data-error="true"` * to turn it red by hand (the form's FormLabel does). */ function Label({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps) { return ( ) } export { Label }
